rationale: Losing Prmt7 opens the Tcf7 locus, so TCF1 rises, and closes the Gzmb locus, so granzyme B falls. The premises report no genotype difference at Klrg1, on CD44 or in per-cell interferon-gamma, so those three are flat, and I see no direct proliferation readout, so I leave Ki67 flat as well.
